note: run-matrix.json and scope.json are hash-bound into the live receipt, and verify_tree_bindings() re-checks them on every launch. Apply only while the queue is idle, then record a new receipt naming all six IDs.
purpose: Add r06/r07 for W1/thingsboard, W2/thingsboard and W3/thingsboard so each reaches three valid repetitions, giving a balanced 12x3 matrix. W2/edgex needed one more slot but was recovered on disk instead (ordinal 44), so it spends no new ID.
why: Each thingsboard cell had exactly five pre-registered IDs. Pre-traffic host failures consumed most of them: W1/thingsboard spent r1,r3,r4,r5; W2/thingsboard spent r2,r5; W3/thingsboard spent r1,r2,r4,r5. That leaves a ceiling of one usable repetition per cell, so two further IDs each are needed to reach three. r06 and r07 fill those slots; no cell gains a fourth repetition, so the design stays balanced at three per cell.
